newsitem.title: USA: Avon Products says earnings soar 53 percent.
newsitem.headline: Avon Products says earnings soar 53 percent.

text.p: Avon Products Inc. said Thursday its fourth quarter earnings soared 53 percent, thanks to double digit growth in cosmetics, fragrance and toiletries sales.

The nation's largest direct seller of beauty and related products said it earned $132 million, or 99 cents a share, in the latest quarter on sales of $1.49 billion compared with year-earlier earnings of $86.5 million, or 64 cents a share, on sales of $1.38 billion.
For all of 1996, Avon said it earned $318 million, or $2.38 a share, compared with 1995 earnings of $256.5 million, or $1.88 a share. Sales rose to a record $4.81 billion from $4.49 billion.

"We are particularly pleased with the performance of Avon U.S., which posted its third straight year of record results, and the Americas region, which expanded at a double digit pace, thanks largely to a dramatic turnaround of Avon Mexico," said Chairman James Preston.

"Equally important for the future, our operations in newer markets like China, Russia and the emerging economies of Central Europe and the Pacific Rim are experiencing very high growth rates," he said.
Avon's stock was up 25 cents at $61.125 on the New York Stock Exchange.
